reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **yes** (Yahoo DSP API: Traffic API + Reporting API + Conversion / Pixel API).
auth: 1. DSP seat; API credentials provisioned per the Setup & Access Guide (page moved — TODO(verify)).
2. "Yahoo DSP API supports the industry-standard OAuth 2.0 protocol for authorization"; bearer token on each call.
3. "To use the Yahoo Conversion API, implement a separate direct OAuth 2.0 authentication."

fields.name: client_id
fields.help: DSP API client ID (DSP UI → your name → My Account → Activate; shown once). The JWT issuer is built as idb2b.dsp.dspapi.<client_id>, so enter the ID without that prefix.

fields.name: client_secret
fields.help: DSP API client secret shown with the client ID; it signs the HS256 client assertion.

me.note: GET /traffic/seats: the seats the API user can access; verifies the JWT client assertion and the X-Auth-Token.

list_accounts.note: GET /traffic/advertisers?page&limit (max 100): advertisers on the seat; the id is the accountId used for campaigns.

list_campaigns.note: GET /traffic/campaigns?accountId&page&limit (max 100). budget/daily_budget come from the first budget schedule (all schedules are in raw.budgetSchedules). `status` is not applied.

not_offered.get_report: The Reporting API is asynchronous: 'To create a new report, call the endpoint using the POST method… To retrieve report status and a URL, call the endpoint using the GET method and specify the customerReportId', and the finished report is a CSV behind a temporary URL (https://help.yahooinc.com/dsp-api/docs/resources) — no single call returns rows.
not_offered.update_budget: Campaign budgets live in budgetSchedules, and an update must name the schedule: budget schedule 'id' is 'Required' on Update, as are 'startDate', 'endDate' and 'scheduleBudgetType' (https://help.yahooinc.com/dsp-api/docs/campaigns); the vocabulary's update_budget carries only campaign_id and daily_budget.

adapter.terms: Yahoo DSP API (https://help.yahooinc.com/dsp-api/docs/setup-access-guide): the user must be enabled for DSP API access on the seat. Access tokens come from the OAuth2 client_credentials grant with an HS256 JWT client assertion signed by the client secret (expiry under 1 hour) and are sent as X-Auth-Token with X-Auth-Method: OAuth2. Default Traffic API limits: 60 GET / 30 PUT per minute (https://help.yahooinc.com/dsp-api/docs/rate-limits).

evidence: host dspapi.admanagerplus.yahoo.com: DNS ok, TLSv1.2 (DigiCert Inc)
